suggested_change: Criterion 1: Clarify whether ICP Fit requires binary pass/fail or allows 'Needs Validation' status with explicit blockers. Criterion 2: Define acceptable carry-forward thresholds (how many consecutive unknown calls before escalation required?). Criterion 5: Establish explicit precedence—if customer status is ambiguous, require blockers before scoring Competition/Champion; do not penalize for unresolved data conflicts in subsequent scoring.
